title: Resolve a persisted CI-watch abort
description: Resolve a persisted blocked CI decision through a running gateway with no live resolver. Seed the run before gateway startup, then set FARMSLOT_RUN_ID and FARMSLOT_DECISION_ID in the recipe runner's environment.

before.intent: Read the persisted blocked run through the gateway before resolving its CI decision.

blocked.intent: Require an operator-blocked run before testing the restart fallback.

abort.intent: Choose Abort through the real gateway RPC after the in-memory CI resolver was lost.

resolved.intent: Confirm the gateway persisted the operator choice.

after.cmd: node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway run.get "$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({runId:process.env.FARMSLOT_RUN_ID}))')" | node -e 'const chunks = []; process.stdin.on("data", chunk => chunks.push(chunk)); process.stdin.on("end", () => { const run = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString()).run; console.log(JSON.stringify({ runStatus: run.status, ciResult: run.steps.find(step => step.name === "ci-watch")?.outputs?.result })); })'
after.intent: Read the run after the gateway re-enters its CI-watch step.

done-status.intent: Require the run to finish instead of remaining blocked.

aborted-result.intent: Require CI-watch to record Abort instead of starting another poll.
